InitDataHeader.name: initdata
InitDataHeader.description: Mini App: Telegram.WebApp.initData. Web: data.init_data from POST /auth/verify-code. Paste the full value without a Bearer prefix. TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=0 disables expiration.

WebSessionCookie.name: qubnix_session
WebSessionCookie.description: Set by POST /auth/verify-code. Web sessions do not expire on the server.

post.summary: Send a web login code to the registered user's Telegram chat
post.description: Codes last 180 seconds. Requesting a new code is currently unrestricted. Returns USER_NOT_FOUND when the phone number is not registered; blocked bots and delivery failures remain generic. No code is returned in the response.

post.summary: Verify a Telegram code and return init_data for web authentication
post.description: Accepts a code once, with at most 5 wrong attempts per code. Returns data.init_data; send this exact value in the initdata header for subsequent web API requests. With TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=0, initdata has no age expiration. Also sets the existing HttpOnly qubnix_session cookie. Codes are strings, including leading zeroes.

post.summary: Log out the current web session
post.description: Deletes the cookie session and clears its cookie. The frontend must also remove its saved init_data. Signed initdata is independent of the cookie session and is not revoked by this endpoint. Repeated logout is successful.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user from Telegram Mini App or web session
get.description: Accepts either Telegram initdata or the qubnix_session cookie. If initdata is provided it takes precedence and must be valid. Web session cookies are renewed on use.

get.summary: List your personal, owned, and joined organizations
get.description: Call when opening the Mini App or web app. Includes your personal workspace first and team organizations you own or actively belong to. tasks_count contains every unfinished task for owners, admins and viewers, and only unfinished tasks assigned to a member. No duplicates. Use the selected id as organizationID in project and task URLs.

post.description: Organization creation is temporarily open without a purchase. Only name is accepted; type=organization and owner are assigned by the server. A purchase requirement can be re-enabled by server configuration. Personal workspaces are created free during registration.

get.summary: Get an accessible organization and your current role

patch.description: Only the owner can rename an organization, including their personal workspace. Members and admins cannot. Only name is editable; type and owner cannot be changed. Module expiry does not prevent renaming.

delete.description: Only the owner can delete a team organization. Soft-deletes the organization, projects and tasks in one transaction. All members lose access. Personal workspaces cannot be deleted. The consumed purchase remains used; deletion does not issue a refund or a new creation credit.

get.summary: List projects in the selected organization
get.description: search searches the project name. Results are newest first. Task counts can be filtered by date or inclusive from/to dates.

post.summary: Create a project and assign its members
post.description: Only the organization owner or admin can create a project. Project roles are project_manager and project_member. There is no project description field.

patch.description: Only the organization owner or admin can update the name and replace the complete member list.

delete.summary: Delete an organization project and its tasks
delete.description: The owner or an admin permanently deletes the project, its tasks and project member links in one transaction.

get.summary: List members assigned to a project

post.summary: Add organization employees to a project

get.summary: List organization employees not assigned to a project

delete.summary: Remove a member from a project
Remove an employee from an organization

get.summary: List active organization employees for project selection
get.description: Returns existing active organization employees. Adding them to a project does not send another invitation.

get.summary: Find a registered employee and load invite choices

post.summary: Invite an employee with a role and projects
post.description: Projects are optional. Without projects, the employee is added only to the organization. Admins access all projects; viewer selections default to project_member; member selections require a project role.

get.summary: List invitations sent for an organization
List invitations received by the current user
